summary: preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: pob-test-package-in-monorepo@5.2.9 declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle whose entire body is a string-array / character-code table with a custom-alphabet decoder — no plaintext URLs, filenames, or API calls are readable. The documented package content is a trivial monorepo demo (lib/index.js contains only `export default 'John'`, README describes 'test pob'); the CHANGELOG stops at 5.2.0 and does not mention setup.mjs, math_init.js, or any preinstall behavior. Fetching an alternate language runtime specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated sibling script at install time — added silently in a patch bump to a package that previously shipped only a string export — is the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time-execution pattern and matches the profile of a hijacked or malicious re-publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
